definition.name: thinking-orb
definition.description: A procedural thinking orb — a scan meridian sweeping a dotted globe, the assistant's "I'm on it" presence.
definition.whenToUse: The thinking indicator for an AI surface — a dotted-globe orb animation, no chrome, no words. Set orbState to match the activity. For a slow morphing ring use thinking-orb-calm; for particles in orbit use thinking-orb-swirl; for three-dot typing feedback keep the wave dots.
